visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a finished bowl of Korean cold noodles featuring kimchi, cucumber, radish, tomato, and chicken shreds. A red can of shallot sauce sits beside it on a wooden table under bright, even lighting. (2) A male chef in a white professional uniform stands in a kitchen studio with a white brick background. He smiles, gestures enthusiastically with both hands, and introduces the cooking concept. (3) The camera shifts to close-up shots of buckwheat noodles being dropped into a pot of boiling water. The chef uses black tongs to stir and eventually drain the noodles. (4) The chef adds a spoonful of dark shallot sauce from a can into a glass bowl of noodles, mixing them thoroughly. Colorful food-related graphics and icons appear as overlays. (5) On a red tray, the chef uses his hands (wearing gloves) to shred a cooked white chicken breast into thin strips. (6) In a clean glass bowl, the chef mixes various liquid ingredients including kimchi juice, vinegar, and more shallot sauce, stirring with a metal spoon until blended. (7) Seaweed sprouts are added to the sauce mixture and tossed. The chef is shown tasting the mixture with a small spoon, expressing satisfaction through a smile. (8) The final assembly involves placing the seasoned noodles into a stainless steel bowl and topping them with the prepared shredded chicken, vegetables, and kimchi. Iced water is poured over the dish. (9) The chef presents the final dish to the camera, gesturing towards it before waving goodbye. (10) The video concludes with a graphical outro screen showing social media icons and related video thumbnails.
